appearance_facts.fact: The chart title is 'Increasing Regional Air Quality Recovery from 2018 to 2023'.
The vertical axis is labeled 'Recovery Score' and has tick marks at 0, 400, 800, 1,200, 1,600, 2,000, 2,400, and 2,800.
The horizontal axis is labeled 'Year' and displays the years 2018 through 2023.
A single blue line graph plots the data points for each year from 2018 to 2023.
The line begins at the year 2018 with a Recovery Score of 2,800.
The line dips to a low point in 2019, at a Recovery Score of 2,400.
The line reaches its highest point in 2020, at a Recovery Score of 2,800.
The line remains flat from 2021 to 2023, at a Recovery Score of 2,400.
